lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately seven distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a semi-regular grid distribution with the highest intensity maxima positioned along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs act as nodal points against the darker background pigment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, originating above the gill region and extending posteriorly. It is defined by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density distribution of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs compared to the more organized, larger spots found on the primary lateral flank.
